scope.baiduPolicy: optional-historical-evidence-only; no new requests in this workflow

acceptancePolicy.acceptedExact: AMap plus one independent authoritative or otherwise strong source proves the same cinema identity, city and branch/mall; brand-only or proximity-only is insufficient.
acceptancePolicy.acceptedLocationOnly: AMap plus independent evidence proves the same mall/venue location but not a reliable cinema POI; granularity must remain mall or venue.
acceptancePolicy.acceptedHistoricalLocation: For closed/removed records, at least two independent sources prove the historical location; current POI existence is not required.
acceptancePolicy.unresolved: Retain when identity, branch, mall/venue, historical relationship or location cannot be safely proven.

priorityPolicy.P1: AMap has a highly specific, likely unique cinema candidate and only independent second evidence is missing.
priorityPolicy.P2: Two or more concrete AMap branch candidates require a mall, district or address check.
priorityPolicy.P3: Mall-only, venue-only or auditorium/location split can be resolved at mall/venue level.
priorityPolicy.P4: Former-name or rename evidence is the main missing link.
priorityPolicy.P5: Closed or removed historical location needs historical web evidence.
priorityPolicy.P6: Weak or genuinely long-tail information; no safe automatic shortcut.

policy.splitBatchRange: 20-30 when the priority group is large enough
policy.p6: follow the same context-aware split rule as other long priority groups
policy.humanResultWriteback: apply one received human-results file in one materialization pass
